description: Meeters helps users discover currently bookable group trips and weekends, compare public prices and trip details, and continue to the official Meeters page. It only reads the public travel catalog and does not access or change accounts, participants, bookings, orders, or payments.

defaultPrompt: Find me a group weekend in Italy under €300.
Compare the best available Meeters trips for my dates and budget.
Show me the price, availability, and details of the best matching trip.
